I am writing to raise a serious formal complaint regarding the repeated failure of the GP at your practice to provide safe, timely, and appropriate medical care to my son

As a direct result of this failure to assess him appropriately, my son’s condition deteriorated, and I was forced to take him to A&E, where clinicians confirmed that he required urgent antibiotic treatment. This situation could and should have been prevented.
